entries.subject: Users/[id]: gate admin balance adjustments to owner (motha) only
entries.body:
No admin except the owner `motha` may see ANY admin balance adjustment on
a user. Enforced server-side at the single query chokepoint
(getUserTransactions) so the admin_balance_adjustment ledger rows are never
sent to the client for a non-owner viewer — across every surface: the
dedicated adjustments block, the Deposits & Withdrawals feed, the Recent
Activity timeline, the transaction-detail modal, and the paginated/filtered
re-fetch via fetchUserTransactions.

- New server-only helper isAdjustmentVisibilityOwner (username === "motha",
  case-insensitive, active, fail-closed), matching the existing founder
  identity convention. Narrower than the salary founder allowlist.
- getUserTransactions resolves the viewer via cached verifySession and ANDs
  a `type != admin_balance_adjustment` exclusion into the where for
  non-owners, so both rows and count omit adjustments. The legacy
  motha-only-profile carve-out now applies only to the owner viewer.
- Defence-in-depth UI: the dedicated adjustments block is owner-gated and
  the Finances type-filter drops the adjustment option for non-owners
  (the server already returns zero such rows). Owner (motha) sees
  everything exactly as before.

tsc + lint (0 errors) + next build pass. Data-flow traced end-to-end;
not yet verified via a live logged-in non-owner click-through.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

entries.subject: Edge Plan 2.0: merge Packs+Battles into one GGR row; fix artifact edges & phantom default profit delta.
entries.body:
The per-type measured gaming edges are accounting artifacts — pack-opens-inside-
battles wager is booked to Packs while the battle item payout is booked to
Battles, so packs reads inflated (~20%) and battles deeply negative (~-61%); only
their sum reconciles. Fixes:

- Merge Packs + Battles into one 'Packs & battles' row (combined wager, planning
  edge on pack opens; battles carry no separate edge — GGR via packs). Removes the
  meaningless -$368k battles settlement row and the battlesGgr that poisoned totals.
- Default edge sliders to the planning targets (10.99% / 10%), NOT the artifact
  per-type measured edges (which opened the page at a fake ~20% packs / 0% upgrader).
- Baseline the planner on the DEFAULT plan, not noisy measured reality, so the
  profit delta is exactly $0 at default and reflects only your changes
  (profitDelta = ggrDelta - rewardCostDelta). Removes the phantom -$130k default delta.

Fixture updated to mirror the real prod artifact (inflated packs, negative battles,
~0% upgrader) to prove the merge renders a sensible positive row regardless.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
